description: This file implements the user creation feature in a web application, including validation, database operations, password hashing, and token generation.

classes.name: Create.UserData
classes.description: Data transfer object representing user input data including username, email, and password.

classes.name: Create.Command
classes.description: Request object encapsulating user data for the create operation, implementing IRequest for MediatR.

classes.name: Create.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validates that user data fields are not null or empty.

classes.name: Create.Handler
classes.description: Handles the creation of a new user, performs database checks, password hashing, and token generation.

classes.name: Create.UserEnvelope
classes.description: Response wrapper containing the created user information and token.

methods.name: Create.CommandValidator.CommandValidator
methods.description: Constructor that sets up validation rules for user data fields.

methods.name: Create.Handler.Handle
methods.description: Processes user creation: checks for existing username/email, hashes password, saves user, and generates a token.
